basic_info.description: Boasting 180-degree views of Mission Bay and Downtown San Francisco, this recently remodeled light-filled Four Bedroom, Two Bath home on the North-West Slope of Potrero Hill offers a modern living experience close to SF's Design District and two blocks from Whole Foods. Combination of original details and modern upgrades. New Eat-in Kitchen with views has custom cabinetry/lighting, breakfast bar w/prof appliances including Subzero fridge, Dacor oven, Bosch range/dishwasher. Living Room w/fireplace & bay windows has French doors that open into Formal Dining Room. Three more bedrooms, all with views, complete this level along with remodeled bath. Newly added Master w/fireplace has office area & bath w/Zuma soaking tub & custom fixtures.
